data.content: Blender Next is a fully open-source, Git-backed content management system designed to make building high-performance marketing landing pages simple. By combining Next.js Server Components with direct visual editing targeting local design files, Blender Next eliminates the performance bottlenecks of traditional database-driven headless solutions.
